caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with an ornate, carved backrest and cabriole-style front legs. The wood is shown in a rich, reddish-brown color, with intricate detailing on the upper backrest, the sides of the seat, and on the knees of the front legs. The chair seat is upholstered in a light fabric, which is decorated with small, scattered floral patterns in soft pastel colors including pink, yellow, and green. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects, creating a neutral setting that isolates and emphasizes the chair itself. The chair is positioned facing directly forward, showing a clear view of its structural elements and decorative features.
title: Chair
